detailed_descriptions.en: Welcome to Ashen Creek . This DLC introduces a brand-new neighborhood packed with fresh opportunities and high-stakes scores. Features: New Map: Explore an entire new neighborhood with over 9 unique spots ready to break into and loot. New Targets: Plan your break-ins and hit high-value places, including a local jewelry store and a pharmacy. New Wheels: Search the area and steal brand-new cars. Deadly Traps: Watch your step and learn to avoid new security measures, such as pressure floors. 3 New Storage Shelves: Store your loot and equipment. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Welcome to Ashen Creek. This DLC introduces a brand-new neighborhood packed with fresh opportunities and high-stakes scores.

Features:

  • New Map: Explore an entire new neighborhood with over 9 unique spots ready to break into and loot.

  • New Targets: Plan your break-ins and hit high-value places, including a local jewelry store and a pharmacy.

  • New Wheels: Search the area and steal brand-new cars.

  • Deadly Traps: Watch your step and learn to avoid new security measures, such as pressure floors.

  • 3 New Storage Shelves: Store your loot and equipment.

  • Hideout Rave: Celebrate your latest scores in the most ridiculous way possible. Pimp your hideout with a disco ball, a glowing dance floor, disco lights, and two LED panels!
